text: Spindle overheating again; coolant flow measured at 5 L/min, coolant filter found clogged and replaced.
Spindle running hot, lubrication unit not pulsing; topped up spindle oil and reset lubrication.
Hydraulic seal leak traced to contaminated oil; seal kit replaced and oil filtered.
Lathe spindle overheating with low coolant flow; coolant pump had an air lock and was re-primed.
Drive belt slipping because belt tension was low; re-tensioned the drive belt.
Servo motor overcurrent caused by a mechanical jam on the linear guide; cleared the jam.
Hydraulic seal leaking oil near the ram; pressure drops to 150 bar under load.
Hydraulic pump cavitation due to low oil level in the reservoir; topped up hydraulic oil.
Spindle overheating during high-speed finishing pass; temperature crossed 92 C and the job was aborted.
Wire feeder slip from worn feed rollers; feed rollers replaced.
Servo motor on axis 2 tripping on overcurrent fault during the pick cycle.
Abnormal vibration from the spindle at 8000 rpm, surface finish out of tolerance.
Welding torch nozzle clogged with spatter, poor bead quality on chassis welds.
Repeat hydraulic seal failure, visible oil seepage on the cylinder wall.
Drive belt misaligned and fraying at the edge.
Grinding noise from the spindle housing, suspected bearing preload issue.
Coolant pump not priming after shift start; low coolant flow alarm raised.
Hydraulic pump making a whining noise, cavitation suspected.
Servo motor encoder error, robot lost its home position.
Wire feeder slipping, inconsistent wire speed causing porosity.
Chuck jaws not clamping evenly, workpiece runout above limit.
Gripper failing to hold parts, vacuum drop observed at the suction cups.
Drive belt snapped during second shift, line stopped for 40 minutes.
Spindle temperature high on the lathe after a continuous 6-hour run.
